loadedAt.description: The piece's first-load time, "HH:MM:SS" (or "…" before #now resolves).

sinceLoad.description: Whole seconds since load, e.g. "12s ago" (or "…").

taps.description: How many times the tap handler has actually been delivered.

lastTapAt.description: Coarse time the last tap was delivered ("—" before the first).

tap.description: The tap event stream (also driven by the button).

typed.description: The current text of the bound `$value` box.

charCount.description: Length of `typed`, derived — updates as the keystroke write propagates.

echo.description: `typed` upper-cased, derived — a second observer of the same cell flip.

type.description: Test-only stream to set the text box (the browser uses the `$value` bind).
